profile.headline: Exadata Imaging and Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Maintainer of Perch - Semantic Code Linter. 5k+ downloads on npm

Exadata Cloud Imaging and Network infrastructure

Former Backend Engineer at Apple

2019 Workday, Inc. Outstanding Innovator Award Recipient

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a live migration state engine for libvirt and QEMU that maintains consistent VM state during transfer and dynamically reconfigures networking, including RDMA timeout handling, GARP updates, and Traffic Control rule management

Developed a high throughput vhost scsi device management framework using rtslib for programmatic Linux LIO target orchestration, supporting 5000 plus disk attachments per KVM host with balanced IRQ distribution and sustained high throughput

Contributed upstream enhancements to targetcli, libvirt, and langchain-oci

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: QEMU · Linux KVM · LangChain · Agentic Workflows

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Parallelized guest VM creation pipeline to support 50 concurrent virtual machine builds

Optimized Linux Traffic Control rule creation and deletion to reduce provisioning latency and improve network isolation performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Build and maintain backend infrastructure for Apple TV content, providing a world class TV experience to over a billion users across the globe.

positions.title: Software Application Engineer II
positions.description:
Candidate Experience Service 
Rebuilding the Workday External Career Site into a Micro-service Architecture powered by Kotlin & Spring Webflux. Writing architecture and code to handle 5 Billion+ Transactions per month

positions.title: Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
HCM - Compensation Team
Design and engineer new features within one of Workday's most utilized product areas. Serve as the Scrum master of a team of developers, product managers, and quality assurance personnel.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Wazlo was co-founded by Dhrubajyoti Das and myself, with the simple vision of improving the recruitment and hiring process. Together we raised over $150,000 from various investors, including the University of California CITRIS Foundry fund, as well as the Government of Australia 

Wazlo tackles the process of vetting job applicants, by automating the first-round interview process. 

With Wazlo, candidates are guaranteed a fair chance at a job opportunity and are immediately interviewed at the time of application. 

Recruiters use Wazlo to deliver fully automated job interviews to job applicants and are provided insights about an applicants technical and cultural fit. 

Learn more at http://www.wazlo.io

positions.title: Fundraising Chairman
positions.description: Helped build a syndicate to support the next generation of student entrepreneurs emerging from UC Davis. Crafted partnerships between students and industry leaders to capitalize on innovations emerging from one of the top global research institutions in the world.  Lead to acquisition by members of the UC Davis Office of Research

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Analyzed Data from multiple studies of exhaled breath condensate (EBC) for the use in modeling complex metabolic pathaways. Used clustering, PLS, and PCA techniques to build models from the data collected.

Wrote multiple software packages for use in biomedical sensors, as well as software tools for analyzing the data they produced. 

Developed experimental methods and standard operation procedures with Gas Chromatography-Differential Mobility Spectrometer (GC-DMS) and Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometer (GC-MS) for a large-scale study to diagnose Huanglongbing (citrus greening) infected citrus plants in a Biosafety Level-3 (BSL-3) containment facility 

Collected Data for NASA's Earth Science Airborne Program studying the Early Detection of Huanglongbing (Citrus Greening) by Airborne Imaging Spectroscopy

You can view my publications here https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=56809755600

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description: Informed incoming Freshman and transfer students about UC Davis degree requirements and helped create personalized academic plans for each student. I was also given the opportunity to be a student moderator as well as a family host. both positions required me to give presentations to groups of over 500 students/family members.

honors.title: Engineering Student Startup Center Grant Funding Program
honors.description: My partner John Zuercher and I were admitted into a 6 month long program in order to validate our idea, construct a business model, develop a MVP, and create a pitch deck proposal to investors aligned with the program. The grant provides funding, innovation space, as well as significant contacts that help develop our idea through the program.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted in founding the Alameda county chapter of Sleep in Heavenly Peace. Helped restore an old barn into a state of the art tools shop where volunteers come build beds for children who do not have one. Participated in the fundraising efforts and helped organize corporate build events.

publications.title: Analytical methodologies for broad metabolite coverage of exhaled breath condensate.
Human breath metabolomics using an optimized non-invasive respiratory sampler for health diagnostics.

organizations.name: UC Davis Inter-Fraternity Council
organizations.position: Vice President of Recruitment · Jan 2015 - Present
organizations.description: Assisted the creation the first ever UC Davis March Against Sexual Assault, an event that drew attendance of almost 2,000 people from across northern California. Was in charge of the social media marketing campaign that received viral attention from across Northern California. Also run a $5k operational budget and lead a committee of 5-10 fellow students to plan and implement campus wide events promoting Greek Life. Ensure that all UC Davis policies regarding Greek Life recruitment are followed and implement disciplinary action when policies are violated.

organizations.name: Sigma Chi Fraternity
organizations.description: Created the chapters most successful social media marketing campaign as the chairman of the Public Relations committee.. Our effort allowed our chapter to raise over $20k for the Huntsman Cancer Society, an increase of over 200% from the previous year
